author: Gavin Waidelich
title: 'Concerned Citizens of Scott County' discuss potential rural power plant - NewsBreak
text:
By Gavin Waidelich ,
1 hours ago
Around 70 people gathered at the Scott County Public Library in Eldridge Wednesday night to oppose a potential power plant.
In February, the Scott County Board of Supervisors voted down a change of ordinance that would allow Central Iowa Power Cooperative (CIPCO) to apply for a permit to build a power plant in Maysville.
Before the vote came in, CIPCO began the process of filing with the Iowa Utilities Commission for a different permit that could allow construction regardless. The company is moving forward with that plan.
Scott County Supervisor Maria Bribriesco says CIPCO’s action undermines local government.
“We know what’s best for the people, the people that reside there,” said Bribriesco. “Zoning is one of those aspects where we have authority. They are free to appeal I guess and go do something else, but I think that shows that they didn’t listen to the people and they aren’t going to be very good neighbors.”
Much of the discussion Wednesday was focused on using up prime farmland.
“In that location that they picked, they’re surrounded by century farms,” said Jerry Mohr, a board member for the Concerned Citizens of Scott County . “Many people don’t know this, but those people have been there for over a hundred years. And all of a sudden you have a company that comes in, and they’re saying ‘x marks the spot.’ We think there’s other locations they can go to.”
CIPCO representatives say the site is ideal because it’s located near a natural gas pipeline and transmission lines, preventing the need for the company to build its own utilities.
“All of those pieces together, that’s why that site was selected,” said Kerry Koonce, a spokesperson for CIPCO. “And because it is a site that is best suited for this plant, we are still moving forward with this process.”
The request for a new permit does require a public information meeting. That’s set for April 6 at the Rhythm City Casino in Davenport at noon.
